script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - DAY

We see JAMES, a mid-level architect, sitting at his desk, staring at blueprints. SARAH, a junior architect, walks in, looking eager.

SARAH
(excited)
Hey James, have you seen the new project? It's for a tech company in the city.

James glances up from the blueprints, intrigued.

JAMES
(interested)
No, I haven't. Let me take a look.

Sarah hands him the folder, and he starts to peruse the designs.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - JAMES' OFFICE - LATER

James is alone, deep in thought, the blueprints spread out on his table. He looks determined.

James (voiceover)
This could be it. The opportunity I've been waiting for.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - STAFF MEETING - DAY

The team gathers in the conference room. The boss, RICHARD, presents the new project.

RICHARD
(excited)
As you all know, we've been selected to design the new headquarters for the tech giant, Innovatech. I want the best team on this project.

Everyone looks around, unsure of where they stand. James raises his hand.

James
(confident)
I'd like to lead the project. I believe I have the right vision for it.

Richard looks thoughtful for a moment, then nods.

RICHARD
(smiling)
James, you're on.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - JAMES' OFFICE - NIGHT

James is late into the night, poring over the designs, his face lit by the glow of his computer screen.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - DAY

The team is gathered around the model of the new building. James presents his vision. The team is impressed.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - JAMES' OFFICE - NIGHT

James is on the phone with Innovatech's CEO, pitching his design. The CEO is skeptical but eventually agrees to a meeting.

INT. INNOVATECH HEADQUARTERS - DAY

James presents his design to the Innovatech team. They are initially hesitant but are won over by James' passion and vision.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - DAY

The team works tirelessly to bring James' vision to life. There are setbacks, but they persevere.

INT. ARCHITECTURE FIRM - JAMES' OFFICE - NIGHT

James receives the good news that Innovatech has approved the design. He is elated, exhausted, but triumphant.

INT. INNOVATECH HEADQUARTERS - DAY

The new building is unveiled to the public. James stands proudly beside the Innovatech CEO, basking in the glory of his success.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
